verdict.rationale: Kling documents a built-in Agent: users brainstorm with it, write scripts, generate images, videos and storyboards, then refine and edit through multiple rounds. Together with prompt-driven text-to-video and text-to-image generation, this means the product itself is operated through natural-language instructions. Missing for 10: detailed docs on which operations the Agent can perform by command (settings, editing scope, project management), and independent or hands-on confirmation that conversational control works as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Brainstorm with your Agent, write scripts, and generate images, videos, and storyboards—then refine and edit your videos through multiple rounds of post-production.
Kling AI specializes in text-to-video, image-to-video, and text-to-image generation
